product.name: Monoprice 4K HDMI Signal Generator & Display Analyzer Tool for Installation and Diagnostics
product.description: Monoprice™HDMI® Signal Generator and Display AnalyzerCompact AV Tool for 4K HDMI Signal Generation, Display Analysis, and HDCP™ TestingThe Monoprice HDMI Signal Generator and Display Analyzer is a versatile tool that simplifies the work of AV installers and technicians by combining signal generation and display analysis in one compact device. Functioning as both an HDMI generator and a display emulator (analyzer), it supports resolutions up to 4K@60 with rich 4:4:4 chroma, ensuring compatibility with modern display technologies.Users can easily adjust video resolutions and manage HDCP settings through a user‑friendly 4‑pin DIP switch, selecting output formats such as 4K@60 4:4:4, 4K@60 4:2:0, 4K@30 4:4:4, and 1080p@60.The device monitors HDCP status and signal conditions‑including 5V and TMDS®‑with LED indicators that clearly display connection and encryption status. It supports HDCP OFF, HDCP 1.4, and HDCP 2.2 modes and includes four test patterns for verifying HDCP versions, ensuring comprehensive compatibility testing and diagnostic accuracy.Additionally, it is backward compatible with USB 2.0 and 1.1, enhancing its versatility across different setups.
